chunks: And what Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ali from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

"The sisters, when with the grandfather, have their prescribed share: if there is one, she gets half; and if there are two or more than that, they get two-thirds; and whatever remains belongs to the grandfather."
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of sisters when the grandfather is the heir?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific rule of *al-jad* (paternal grandfather) inheriting alongside sisters, a key point of discussion in Shia jurisprudence regarding the exclusion (*hijr*) of the father. It establishes that the sisters' share is fixed at half or two-thirds depending on their number, with the residual estate (*al-fadl*) accruing to the grandfather, reflecting the principle that the grandfather stands in the place of the father when the latter is absent.
